main_text.p: tempora, quæ Photianum Schisma antecesserant; aliàs fore, ut prisci Orientalis Ecclesiæ Patres damnandi sint, si verum sit, Græcos recentiores in Sacramentorum Administratione cum his ut plurimum consentire.

Viris sapientioribus rerumque Ecclesiasticarum bene peritis placuit illud Morini judicium, summaque illius eruditio laudata fuit etiam à Cardinale Barberino. Mirum tamen est, tunc temporis illam Romæ approbatam fuisse sententiam, quæ fidem prope omnē & autoritatem detraheret Theologis Scholasticis, quos quadrigentos abhinc annos Ecclesia Romana Doctrinæ suæ Magistros acceperat in iis omnibus, quæ de fide & moribus tulit decretis. Illudque adhuc videtur admirabilius, quod præcipui sententiæ illius autores Lucas Holstenius, Joannes Morinus, Leo Allatius, & alii hujus conterranei, vel ex Protestantium, vel ex Græcorum Scholis exissent. Rem tamen ita gestam fuisse, uti eam narravimus, ex ipsius Morini schedulis, quæ in manus meas, pervenerunt,

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. The printed v for u in "qvæ", "qvod", "qvadrigentos" is normalised to u. "Photianum Schisma" is printed with the long-s form "Schisma". The line "schedulis" is printed with a broken "sch" ligature; read as "schedulis". The final line of the page is printed flush right as "&in", which is the catchword for the next page, not a line of text.
